findings.title: Products hidden until an account exists
findings.clause: Before shopping for or purchasing any product, a visitor must set up an account, provide the institution they are affiliated with, and electronically acknowledge that everything sold on the site is intended for research use.

findings.note: The sign-up form at https://www.comopeptides.com/my-account/ was read in full and carried no checkbox. 2 field(s) were observed: "Email address *Required" [email] (email, required); "Password *Required" [password] (password, required).
findings.title: Terms acknowledged at sign-up
findings.clause: The user must actively check “I Agree” against the complete Terms and Conditions. Until they do, account creation cannot proceed.

findings.note: 1 of 3 path(s) served content directly with a status this rule treats as a violation: https://www.comopeptides.com/shop returned 200. Each was requested with no session — what an anonymous visitor sees.
findings.title: Products hidden until an account exists
findings.clause: Before shopping for or purchasing any product, a visitor must set up an account, provide the institution they are affiliated with, and electronically acknowledge that everything sold on the site is intended for research use.

findings.note: The sign-up form at https://www.comopeptides.com/my-account/ carried only fields used to create an account. All 2 field(s) observed: "Email address *Required" [email] (email, required); "Password *Required" [password] (password, required). No field beyond that set was present to identify research status.
findings.title: Research field required at sign-up
findings.clause: When the account is established, the buyer must identify their research status. This is a required field — never optional.

attestationQuestions.question: Do you ship only within the USA, excluding PO boxes and international addresses?
Do you ship to gyms, med-spas, wellness clinics or weight-loss clinics?
Do first-time orders require an adult signature at 21+?
Does the packing slip carry the RUO disclaimer and research acknowledgement?
Do you maintain a permanent ban list for customers who indicate human use?
Are bans documented and permanent, with no appeal?
Do support staff ever provide dosing, administration or protocol guidance — by email, chat, phone or DM?
What is your standard support response to a dosing question?
Do staff offer to help customers "figure out" protocols?
Do any social accounts contain human-use claims, testimonials or outcome stories?
Do you pay or barter with influencers?
How often are social channels audited, and by whom?
Do you monitor third-party brand mentions and issue cease-and-desist notices?
Is your COA lab independent and accredited? Which accreditation?
How often do you receive new batches, and how quickly are COAs updated?
Do you accept payment through any channel other than card processing?
Do you operate any other storefronts, brands or domains selling the same products?
Do you store the declared research field with every order?
Has any acquirer, processor or platform terminated you?
